description: SSOT for Town of Wiley custom AWS resources. Static hosting (S3+CloudFront) lives in official Town account 818904800844 (profile tow) as of 2026-08-20. Gen 1 AppSync/Cognito/docs storage and most Lambdas still in Steve personal 570912405222 until backend migration. hosting.note: Cut over 2026-08-20. Public DNS (still hosted in 570 zone until NS move) A/AAAA aliases point at E19PUUL2H76CZA. Deploy with AWS_PROFILE=tow.
hosting.deployCommand: npm run build && aws s3 sync dist/townofwiley-app/browser s3://townofwiley-static-site-818904800844 --delete --cache-control 'public, max-age=31536000, immutable' --exclude 'index.html' --exclude 'runtime-config.js' --exclude '*/*.html' --profile tow && aws s3 sync dist/townofwiley-app/browser s3://townofwiley-static-site-818904800844 --delete --cache-control 'no-cache, no-store, must-revalidate' --include 'index.html' --include 'runtime-config.js' --include '*/*.html' --profile tow && aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E19PUUL2H76CZA --paths "/*" --profile tow
